parsed.scene_description: A narrow aisle in a brightly lit convenience store, flanked by shelves packed with colorful snack packages. A person in dark clothing walks away from the camera toward the back. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. A blue promotional sign is visible near the center.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a black shirt and pants walks away from the camera down the aisle. Their back is to the viewer, and they appear to be holding something in their right hand. They are positioned centrally between the two shelves.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Metal shelves line both sides of the aisle, filled with various packaged snacks in bright colors like yellow, green, red, and pink. The left shelf is more densely stocked and closer to the camera.

objects.label: decorative lights
objects.observation: Two hot air balloon-shaped decorative lights hang from the ceiling above the aisle. One is white with yellow stripes, the other is red and white striped. They are suspended by thin wires and positioned near the center of the frame.

objects.label: promotional sign
objects.observation: A blue rectangular sign with white and light blue text is mounted on the wall at the end of the aisle. It features Chinese characters and a circular logo. It is partially obscured by the person walking past it.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Fluorescent tube lights are mounted on the black ceiling, providing illumination for the aisle. They are positioned above the shelves and the person walking.
